# GraphemeBreak

The grapheme break class of a scalar value.

```rux
pub enum GraphemeBreak: int32 {
    Any = 0,
    CarriageReturn = 1,
    LineFeed = 2,
    Control = 3,
    Extend = 4,
    ZeroWidthJoiner = 5,
    RegionalIndicator = 6,
    Prepend = 7,
    SpacingMark = 8,
    HangulL = 9,
    HangulV = 10,
    HangulT = 11,
    HangulLV = 12,
    HangulLVT = 13
}
```

`Copy`.
The ordinals match the generated table and must not be reordered.

## Cases

| Name                | Value | Description                                                 |
| ------------------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Any`               | `0`   | Everything with no class of its own.                        |
| `CarriageReturn`    | `1`   | A carriage return, which joins only the line feed after it. |
| `LineFeed`          | `2`   | A line feed.                                                |
| `Control`           | `3`   | A control character, which stands alone.                    |
| `Extend`            | `4`   | A mark that extends the cluster before it.                  |
| `ZeroWidthJoiner`   | `5`   | The zero-width joiner, which is what glues emoji sequences. |
| `RegionalIndicator` | `6`   | A regional indicator, half of a flag.                       |
| `Prepend`           | `7`   | A prefix that binds to what follows it.                     |
| `SpacingMark`       | `8`   | A spacing mark, kept with what precedes it.                 |
| `HangulL`           | `9`   | A Hangul leading consonant.                                 |
| `HangulV`           | `10`  | A Hangul vowel.                                             |
| `HangulT`           | `11`  | A Hangul trailing consonant.                                |
| `HangulLV`          | `12`  | A Hangul LV syllable.                                       |
| `HangulLVT`         | `13`  | A Hangul LVT syllable.                                      |
